text:
morgan: Heads-up: we're seeing a regression in eu-west1 embeddings (intermittent 503s) since ~21:50 UTC. I pushed a small restartless hotfix branch that patches a KV eviction race. Requesting expedited approval for a short change window at 22:05-22:25 UTC so we can roll with a cautious canary.

deploy-bot: /deploy request created: repo=rl-inference, ref=hotfix/evict-fix-1.2.4, env=eu-west1, strategy=restartless-canary. ID=DBOT-10021.

tia: Need the rollback steps and gating criteria before I can greenlight. Ops wants runbook + exact thresholds.

sre-oncall: TL;DR risk: tiny logic fix, low functional risk. Operational: cache warmup may increase p99 for a few minutes. Rollback plan: pin traffic to v1.2.2 and run forced-clear job. Fallback triggers: error-rate > 2.5% sustained 5m OR p99 > 850ms sustained 5m.

alex: Product +1 if ops signs off on runbook.

emily: Proposed canary: 0.5% for 10m, then 5% for 10m, then promote to 100%. Auto-fallback if error-rate >2.5% or p99 >850ms.

release-manager: Draft changelog line: "hotfix(embeddings): fix intermittent 503s in eu-west1 caused by KV eviction race (v1.2.4)" — will publish when deploy completes.

morgan: Runbook posted: https://runbooks/internal/kv-evict-hotfix. Includes rollback commands and a `kubectl run clear-kv --image=ops/kvclear:stable --env=eu-west1` task. Dashboards: https://dashboards/embeddings?region=eu-west1

deploy-bot: Canary plan suggested: 0.5% / 10m -> 5% / 10m -> 100%. Fallback: auto-pin to v1.2.2 on triggers. Scheduled start: 2025-11-12T22:05:00Z (inside window).

morgan: Ops command to kick off:
```
deploybot run DBOT-10021 --canary 0.5,5 --stabilize 10m,10m --fallback-tag v1.2.2
```

tia: Runbook validated. Monitoring hooks, PD escalation, and traffic-pin playbook reviewed.

alex: Approved. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: I'll be watching the p99 and error-rate and am on pager. If thresholds hit, I'll post "rollback intent" here and trigger the pin.

emily: pinging @platform-ops to have traffic-steering ready.

platform-ops: standing by to pin or reroute.

deploy-bot: T-minus 4m to scheduled start. Any objections?

morgan: none. go for it.

deploy-bot: STARTED DBOT-10021 0:05Z – rolling 0.5% canary. Status: https://deploys/dbot/10021/status

deploy-bot: CANARY CHECK (5m): errors 0.4% (baseline 0.15%), p99 +90ms. Within gates.

morgan: logs show no new exception classes. traces look normal.

sre-oncall: monitoring OK so far. p99 bump expected then settling.

deploy-bot: PROMOTED to 5% after canary stable.

deploy-bot: 5% running 0:15Z — observing for 10m.

emily: no customer reports. metrics look steady.

sre-oncall: p99 trending down; errors ~0.7%. safe to finish promotion if timer clears.

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE: v1.2.4 at 100% in eu-west1. No fallback triggered. Audit: https://deploys/dbot/10021/audit

release-manager: Published release note to internal changelog and notified support channels. Tag: v1.2.4.

morgan: thanks all — closing thread.

alex: nice quick turnaround. :tada:

sre-oncall: closing monitoring loop, will reopen if anything flares up.
